name: Render Skills
summary: Official Render Agent Skills for deploys, logs, and SSH against a Render account. MIT pack in render-oss/skills; live Render usage is billed separately.
description: Vendor-affiliated listing (Render). The render-oss/skills repository is MIT (Copyright (c) 2026 Render), not archived, and was pushed 2026-11-03. The README claims 21 skills. The pack is free to install; paid Render usage is separate and was not purchased. docs.render.com/skills 301s and render.com/docs/skills returned HTTP 404 on 2026-11-17, so those URLs are not used as docs or sources; documentation is the GitHub README. Documented installs were not executed. The recommended path is `render skills install` via the Render CLI; also `npx skills add render-oss/skills`, and Claude Code `/plugin marketplace add render-oss/skills` then `/plugin install render@skills`. Prerequisites stated in the README: a Render account, the Render MCP or CLI, a RENDER_API_KEY, and a git repo for deploy skills. Skills can deploy, SSH, and read logs — those are side-effecting against the operator's Render account. Auto-approval hooks are documented only for Claude Code. No signup or spend. This entry does not set mcp_endpoint.
